children: Luvu Brands reported fiscal 2026 net sales of $27.36 million, a 5.8% increase year-over-year, with gross margin expanding to 31.5%. The company returned to operating profitability with operating income of $876,000 and posted Adjusted EBITDA of $1.26 million. Cash from operations turned positive to $773,000 and cash and cash equivalents rose to $1.20 million as of June 30, 2026.
Net sales: $27.36 million for fiscal 2026 (up 5.8% from $25.86 million in FY2025).
Gross profit: $8.61 million; gross margin improved to 31.5% (up 200 basis points from 29.5%).
Operating income: $876,000 for FY2026 (compared with an operating loss of $69,000 in FY2025).
Adjusted EBITDA: $1.26 million for FY2026 (up from $395,000 in FY2025).
Net loss: $(246,000) for FY2026; diluted net loss per share $(0.00). Cash and cash equivalents: $1.20 million.
Wholesale growth led revenue increase: wholesale net sales rose 8% to $19.06 million, driven by expansion of the dropship network and higher international and new-customer demand.
Direct-to-consumer channel grew 2% to $8.30 million, supported by marketing initiatives for Liberator, Jaxx, and Avana e-commerce sites.
Continued investment in vertically integrated, Made in USA manufacturing, including renewal of the operating lease for a 140,000-square-foot Atlanta facility and expanded woodworking capabilities.
Operational cost initiatives reduced headcount in warehouse and production, improved inventory forecasting, and expanded raw material sourcing, contributing to margin expansion.
Management revised FY2025 presentation to reclassify $1.16 million of Amazon fulfillment fees from a reduction of net sales to selling expense for comparability.
